description: Wraps the Steam reviews endpoint, requesting the summary only (num_per_page=0 / filter=summary equivalent) so payloads stay small, pinned to the same locked locale as the storefront calls.
signature: def fetch_review_summary(self, appid: int) -> tuple[int, dict]
docstring:
Fetch the review summary for one appid.

Args:
    appid: The Steam application id.

Returns:
    (status_code, payload) from HttpClient.get_json. On success, payload contains query_summary with total_positive, total_negative, total_reviews, review_score, review_score_desc.

Note (locale): pinned to cc=us&l=english (language filter on the reviews endpoint affects which review-language subset the summary counts are computed over on some Steam endpoints; 'english' is used consistently with appdetails per ARCHITECTURE.md's locale-pinning decision, so both figures are computed on the same basis).
postconditions: Requests zero review bodies (only the summary block), keeping response payload size minimal per the module's design note
Returns the tuple as-is from HttpClient.get_json

edge_cases.input: appid with zero reviews at all
edge_cases.expected_behavior: returns 200 with total_reviews=0, total_positive=0, total_negative=0 -- not an error

edge_cases.input: appid does not exist / was delisted
edge_cases.expected_behavior: Steam's reviews endpoint typically still returns 200 with a success=1 and zero counts, or success=0; returned unchanged either way

unit_tests.name: test_fetch_review_summary_parses_fixture
unit_tests.description: tests/fixtures/reviews_summary.json is returned unchanged as payload.
